suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 is in Kotlin build cache metadata (compiler tooling). TaskFlow compiles no Kotlin; kotlin-stdlib arrives at runtime via spring-ai-starter-model-openai. Matched by the product-wide Kotlin CPE.
CVE-2022-31691 is in the Spring Tools IDE extensions, not spring-boot-devtools. Matched by CPE only; devtools is optional and excluded from the packaged jar.
